item.title: When They Make You Want To Scream AAA!
item.description: Read When They Make You Want To Scream AAA! A customer walks in and hands me an open pack of non-rechargeable batteries. Customer: "I need to return these." Me: "Did they not work?" Customer: "They did at first, but then they stopped." Read When They Make You Want To Scream AAA!

item.title: Get One Of Those Multicolored Pens And Blow Everyone’s Mind!
item.description: Read Get One Of Those Multicolored Pens And Blow Everyone’s Mind! Me: "Are there any red pens?" Assistant: *Shrill and urgent.* "Are you a manager?!" Me: "No, I was just hired as an engineer—" Assistant: "—Only managers get red pens!" Read Get One Of Those Multicolored Pens And Blow Everyone’s Mind!

item.title: When The Cold Snap Makes You Snap
item.description: Read When The Cold Snap Makes You Snap Customer: "So, do I qualify for a discount?" Me: "For what reason, sir?" Customer: "Because I'm still here shopping when it's cold out. I'm bringing you business!" Read When The Cold Snap Makes You Snap

item.title: Pay No Mind
item.description: Read Pay No Mind This is when a new customer arrives and, of course, I move to give her some space at the counter. I wonder for a second why she doesn’t move on to give her order. I glance quickly at the barista. She proceeds to ask me in the sweetest voice, with maybe some fear in her eyes: Read Pay No Mind

item.title: Please Discard All Liquids And Bigotry Before Entering Security
item.description: Read Please Discard All Liquids And Bigotry Before Entering Security Guy: *Handing me their passports.* "Yeah, we're going to Bali." Me: "Oh, how nice!" The guy then looks up and down the check-in area and leans in to whisper. Guy: "Yeah, Sydney is getting waaaay too Muslim lately, so we needed a break from it, know what I mean?" Read Please Discard All Liquids And Bigotry Before Entering Security
